Python API reference

Policies

Centralise role, ownership and subscription query policies.

These helpers expect an authenticated news.models.User. Callers protect private views with login_required or authenticated API permissions.

news.policies.can_edit(user, article)[source]

Allow editors and the owning journalist to edit an article.

Parameters:

  • user (news.models.User) – The authenticated account requesting a change.

  • article (news.models.Article) – The persisted article being changed.

Returns:

True for an editor or the article’s journalist author.

Return type:

bool

news.policies.is_editor(user)[source]

Recognise the editor role or explicit Editor group membership.

Parameters:

user (news.models.User) – The authenticated account whose role is checked.

Returns:

Whether either editor check succeeds.

Return type:

bool

news.policies.subscribed_articles(user)[source]

Return approved articles matching this reader’s subscriptions.

Publisher subscriptions select their published articles; journalist subscriptions select independent articles. Duplicates are removed.

Parameters:

user (news.models.User) – The account whose subscriptions are evaluated.

Returns:

A lazy queryset, empty for non-reader accounts.

Return type:

django.db.models.QuerySet

news.policies.visible_articles(user)[source]

Scope article visibility according to role and ownership.

Parameters:

user (news.models.User) – An authenticated account.

Returns:

All articles for editors; approved or owned articles for journalists; approved articles for readers.

Return type:

django.db.models.QuerySet

Approval and delivery

Approve reporting transactionally and attempt external delivery.

Approval commits before delivery runs. Email and API outcomes are stored independently so already-completed channels can be skipped on retry.

news.services.approve_article(article, editor)[source]

Commit editor approval before scheduling notification delivery.

Parameters:

  • article (news.models.Article) – An existing article; its database row is locked.

  • editor (news.models.User) – The approving authenticated editor.

Returns:

The approved article refreshed inside the transaction.

Return type:

news.models.Article

Raises:

  • PermissionError – If the account is not an editor.

  • news.models.Article.DoesNotExist – If the article was removed.

news.services.deliver_article(article_id, editor_id)[source]

Attempt email and API delivery, recording errors for later retry.

An unapproved article is ignored. Delivery exceptions are recorded in PublicationDelivery.last_error. Database lookup errors still propagate. Email delivery can repeat some recipients after a partial batch failure.

Parameters:

  • article_id (int) – Primary key of the article to deliver.

  • editor_id (int) – Account used to authenticate the approval callback.

Returns:

No value; delivery state is persisted.

Return type:

None

Raises:

news.models.Article.DoesNotExist – If the article is absent.

Domain models

Persist role-aware users, publishers, reporting and delivery status.

Relationships are normalised with foreign keys and many-to-many tables. Role-aware User properties return None where a relationship is inapplicable.

class news.models.User(*args, **kwargs)[source]

An authenticated account with reader, editor or journalist workflow.

Reader subscriptions are stored separately from publisher staff membership. Save signals synchronise the role with the corresponding Django group.

django.db.models.QuerySet or None

property reader_subscriptions
